name: Wind Blade
description: A sword without a costume? Oh no, look, there's a sharp wind around it!
usage: Push 1 meteor, reset meteor duration to maximum

name: Stop Watch
description: What's the use of a broken watch?

name: Shield
description: This shield is so beautiful! Wish it was here forever
usage: Quantum shield, helps the spacecraft block 1 damage

name: Supply Kit
usage: Use immediately restores 10% of maximum health (Full will restore shield)

name: Magnetic
description: With the force of fate, these meteorites need a little help
usage: Creates a link between 2 meteorites, answering 1 meteorite correctly will destroy both meteorites (If 1 meteorite answers incorrectly, you can still answer the remaining question to destroy both)

name: Gum Bomp
description: What kind of bomb sticks like glue?
usage: Place the bomb in one location, when the meteorite sticks it will explode, causing the meteorite to stand still for 2 seconds

name: Hacker ID
usage: Only use when answering a question, immediately display the answer and answer
